links.outcome: LLM judgment of whether available information is sufficient for a decision, when a relevant factor is added
links.effect: Adding a relevant factor made LLMs more likely to select the augmented case as determinable even when it remained undeterminable; the effect persisted with increased reasoning effort. Numbers not reported in the text.
links.quote: Adding a relevant factor made LLMs more likely to select the augmented case as determinable even when it remained undeterminable, an effect that persisted with increased reasoning effort, while adding irrelevant text made them less likely to select the augmented case, an effect that reasoning substantially reduced.

unlisted_practices: Evaluating LLM determinability judgments (knowing when to stop gathering information) under underspecified clinical information, including factor coverage bias

screen.reason: Empirical benchmark evaluation assessing LLM bias (factor coverage bias) in clinical determinability judgments under underspecified information.
